result:
If I could change just one thing, it would be to make empathy as automatic and reflexive as self-preservation.

Not just kindness when it's convenient, but a built-in, almost involuntary capacity to feel the cost of your actions on other people — strangers, future generations, animals, the planet — the same way you feel pain when you touch something hot.

Most of the world's cruelty, waste, and short-sightedness isn't from malice. It's from distance. If that distance were gone, everything else — how we design economies, wars, cities, technology, even conversations — would change on its own.
